title: Caveman: A Claude Code skill that forces your AI to talk like a literal caveman
description:
Why use many token when few token do trick. Caveman is a Claude Code skill that forces your AI to talk like a literal caveman. No pleasantries, no filler paragraphs, no hedging. Just bare-bones primitive sentences with 100% of the technical accuracy intact. Cuts output tokens by up to 75%. It even auto-reverts to normal English for critical security warnings before doing something destructive.

https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman

#github #opensource
